purpose: Evaluate universe control, method-specific QC, reproducibility, and evidence-bounded interpretation.

cases.task: Run over-representation analysis on a filtered gene list.
must_include: species ID type and mapping counts
must_not: treat pathway names as mechanism proof

cases.task: Run GSEA on a complete ranked result table.
must_not: threshold the ranked list into an unexplained foreground

cases.task: Construct and analyze a PPI or biological graph.
must_not: mix predicted and experimental edges without labels

cases.task: Review a pathway analysis that only retained top-term figures.
must_not: reconstruct missing parameters from plot appearance
treat top terms as the complete tested universe
approve manuscript claims without recoverable evidence

cases.task: Handle a request to call a central hub or enriched pathway a proven disease mechanism.
must_not: state causality from enrichment or centrality
present database association as direct experiment
